verdict.rationale: Figma explicitly documents write-capable surfaces for agents: the MCP server supports writing to the canvas, generating designs from live UI, and generating FigJam diagrams (figma-docs-1, figma-docs-5, figma-docs-6), and the Plugin API explicitly supports read/write access to create and modify file contents (figma-docs-8, figma-docs-32). This is corroborated by a live runtime probe confirming the hosted MCP endpoint is real and speaks MCP/OAuth (figma-probe-rt-2). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the write-to-canvas MCP tool succeeding in practice (only the auth handshake was probed, not an actual write operation).
